integrity_statement: Analytic theorem and reproducible deterministic diagnostics; no claims of independent audit or formal certification.
scientific_limitations: Assumes a stationary one-dimensional Brownian diffusion, independent Poisson reset clock and iid uniformly strict contractive real factors. It proves no entropy production identity, finite-data statistical power, or theorem for noncontractive factors. Independent publication-priority assessment is outstanding.
title: A universal minimal-degree time arrow for randomly rescaled Brownian resetting
